mechanism: A safety pattern where an agent performs an explicit {{audit}} of the {{state}} immediately after a write to ensure the {{state_transition}} occurred as expected. Catches silent API failures.
gloss: Verifying system state after an operation
invariants: Audit timestamp is later than the write it verifies.
Compares observed {{state}} against the {{state_transition}} that was expected, not merely that a write returned.
failure_modes: Silent write failure: the write reported success and the {{state}} did not change. This is the case the pattern exists for.
Audit reads a stale replica, so a successful write looks silently failed.
